(315)༄༅/ /su kha siddhi'i zhal gdams kyi skor dang*/gzer gsum gdams pa rnams

tei:div.tei:p: "$ (315)༄༅// su kha siddhi'i zhal gdams kyi skor dang*/ gzer gsum gdams pa rnams

bzhugs so/ (316)༄༅// na mo gu ru/ gsang dbang bzhi'i zhal gdams sgrub lte ba sprul 'khor gyi// dbang bzhi'i zhal gdams bri bar bya// de la sems bskyed sngon du song bas/ rang skad cig gis bde mchog dpa' bo gcig pa rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams pa/ rnam pa gzugs su grub pa/ reg pa rdzas su ma grub pa/ bde ba'i nyams dang ldan pa gcig bsgom/ de'i lte ba'i a las 'od zer tshangs pa'i bu ga nas yar song bas/ 'od kyi rtse la lha'i bu mo sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ gzhon nu lang tsho dar la bab pa/ sku sha rgyas shing nu ma 'bur ba/ sku gzhon zhing sgeg pa/ rin po che dang*/ lha'i pañtsa li ka'i gos sna tshogs kyis brgyan zhing mdzes pa/ mdun dang padma shin tu gsal zhing chags pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa/ mthong ba'am/ thos pa'am/ reg pa tsam gyis bde drod dpag tu med pa skye bar byed pa'i rje btsun ma de lta bu gcig mdun du byon par bsam mo// de nas rang bde mchog tu gsal ba'i nor bu'i rtse la hūm̐ mthing nag gcig bsam/ de las 'od (317)zer lnga 'phros/ mdun gyi lha mo'i gsang gnas na yar 'phros pas/ de bde bas brgyal ba dang*/ 'od zer des bde ba bkug nas rang gi nor bu'i nang na yar bde phri li li/ tsha chi li li song ba dang 'og rlung drag tu bskum nas/ bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes par bsam/ yang hūm̐ las 'od 'phros/ padma na yar song ba dang*/ bde ba thams cad tshur bsdus nas nor bu'i nang na yar song ba dang*/ bde ba de nyid gsal sing ba gsal stong gnyis med kyi ye shes rgyud la skye'o// yang hūm̐ las 'od 'phros padma na yar song ba dang*/ bde bas myos nas bdag la kyud kyis byung nas/ sbyor ba byas pa dang*/ sbyor mtshams nas chags pa'i zil pa thigs tsam thigs tsam byung bas/ bde phril phril ba la/ lus thams cad bde bas khyab pa dang*/ 'og rlung drag tu 'then no// de nas nor bu'i bu gar yum gyi bde ba'i rtsa dang byang sems dmar po rnams tshud pa dang*/

'og rlung drag tu bskum byas pa dang byang sems dmar po (318)rnams nor bu'i nang na yar bde phri li li/ tsha chil li li/ dmar na ra ra byung gsang gnas dang lte ba man chad khengs pas bde ba drag po skyes/ yang snying ga dang mgrin pa dang*/ spyi bo man chad dmar mer gyis khengs pas lus thams cad bde bas khengs par bsam/ de nas rang nyid bde la dmar ba'i byi ru'i mdog lta bur gyur pa'i mdangs des yum dbang du bsdus/ yum gyi mkha' la dkar ba gcig spros pas yum kyang bde bas brgyal te/ dkar ba la dmar ba'i mdangs chags par bsgom/ de ltar yab yum gnyis ka bde bas brgyal te/ bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ngang la gnas par bya'o// de la mas brtan gyi dga' bzhi yang rtsi bar bya'o// de bzhin du dri za'i bu mo dkar ba la ljang khu'i mdangs chags pa dang*/ bram ze ljang khu la dkar ba'i mdangs= gdol pa dmar ba la dkar= klu ser ba la dkar= mi yid du gang 'ong ba'o// de ltar drug ka rim gyis bsgom par bya'o/ dbang bzhi bla ma sum ldan 'di// mkha' 'gro bde ba'i dngos grub kyis// sangs rgyas gnyan ston rin chen la// dngos su gsungs nas bdag la gnang*// dpa' bo ḍā ki'i srog snying 'dis// lo zla tsam gyis mngon sangs rgya// /ngo sprad kyi zhal gdams ni/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// mkha' 'gro dang rang sems gnyis med du rang sems phyag rgya chen po ngo sprad pa ni/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor ni rkang pa cung zad bsnol/ lag pa g.yon pa sdigs mdzub byas pa la thugs kar bzung*/ g.yas pa'i mtheb chen dang*/ mthe'u chung gnyis bcangs pa sor mo gsum gdengs tshul du byas/ ldan pa yi// nam mkha' rig med stong pa la// rig bcas dmigs sems kyi rtsa ba gcun mig hur re blta/ / rtsa ba gcun dang lhug par bzhag /mi phod pa brdzis/ 'khri ba bcad/ zhen pa bzlog /snang ba bsgyur bar bya/ (319)spyod pa skyungs/

'tshangs yul nas 'don/ rkyen dngos grub tu shes par bya/ sdug bsngal chos nyid du shes par bya/ 'dod pa dbang du bsdu bar bya/ mi 'dod pa gzhil bar bya/ tshogs drug lhug par bzhag /des 'khor 'das thams cad rang grol du 'gro gsung ngo*/ /rig pa khrol dbyung*/ snyan brgyud mi la ma spel cig /de ltar nyams su blangs pas rten 'brel mngon du ji lta ba bzhin 'char te tshe 'di nyid du rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang thob nas nus pa dang yon tan phrin las lhun gyis grub pa rgyun chad med pas/ 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho ma stongs par sems can smin cing grol bar byed do// de la mkha' 'gro gnang la dbab pa'i gdams pa ni/ dbang po la khrog dbyung*/ rig pa la gsal gdab/ bzhin gyi ngar blud/ rtsa ba dran pas bzung*/ mkha' 'gro rang sems sems skye med phyag rgya chen por shes pa/ su ngo sprad/ des snang ba dang mkha' 'gro thams cad dbang du 'du'o// gsang sgrub kyi zhal gdams rdzogs so// / ༈ sgrub pa'i zhal gdams ni/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus btud nas// gsang skye ba med par/ sgrub zhal gdams bri bar bya/ de la bdag bskyed sngon du song pas/ rang skad cig gis rje btsun mar bskyed pa'i rtsa dbu ma gsal gdab/ de'i lte bar padma 'dab bzhi la/ mdun sngo skya/ g.yas dmar/ rgyab dkar/ g.yon ser po bsam/ dbus kyi lte ba dkar po la a dkar po bsam/ de nas mdun gyi nam mkha' la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bsam/ de'i mdun du hūm̐ las dgyes mdzad dang bir wa pa tha dad med par bsgom/ de'i g.yon du haṃ las bdag med ma dang (320)su kha siddhi tha dad med par bsgom/ rang gi spyi bor dam pa phyag na spa'i gling bu rtsa dbu ma la reg ge ba bsnams pa/ dam pa'i mdun du bla ma bzhugs par bsam nas/ rje btsun bir wa pa hūm̐/ su kha ma siddhi haṃ/ zhes gsol ba lan gsum btab pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang sems thams cad dang*/

khyad par bir wa pa hūm̐/ su kha ma siddhi hūm̐/ dam pa gsum gyi thugs ka nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ mu tig dar la brgyus pa bzhin du dam pa'i spa'i gling bu'i nang na mar song*/ rtsa dbu ma brgyud nas yi ge bzhi la sib sib thim pas/ nyams chags nus pa smad par bsgoms nas/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro gsum la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes grub tshad byas pas/ bdag mkha' 'gro'i dbang du mi 'gro zhing*/ mkha' 'gro bdag gi dbang du 'du ba'i gnad yin no// de nas bzlas pa ni/ a dkar po las 'od 'phros/ ngo bo lha mo rnam pa yi ge gsang gnas su thim pas/ nyams chags nus pa smad nas bde phril phril/ 'od du ltem ltem 'dug par bsams nas/ yi ge bzhi po gang bas thos tsam du bzlas pas/ yi ge mi 'khor bar padma g.yas bskor du sgo ro ro 'khor bar bsams la/ lus mi gnas sgul bskyod/ ngag mi gnas bzlas pa/ yid mi gnas chos nyid la gnas par bya'o// de nas rmi lam 'dzin cing sbyong bar 'dod na āḥlas 'od zer spro ba/ padma 'khor ba rnams las sgyu ma yin/ rmi lam yin snyam pa yid la sems shing ngag tu'ang brjod la/ spyod lam thams cad du sgyu ma rmi lam gyi dran 'dun bya'o// dbang du sdud na sgrub bya thams cad a'i 'od zer gyis bkug nas yi ge dang padma la bstim nas 'dun pa dang chags pa drag tu btang ngo*// bde ba 'dod na 'og rlung bskum padma bde ba'i rang bzhin (321)'khor bas/ rang gi sha la reg ge byung nas bde ba khyad par can skyes par bsam/ drod 'dod na a las 'od zer tsha ba'i rang bzhin 'phros/ yi ge bzhi dang padma las 'od dmar po tsha ba'i rang bzhin 'phros pas/ khong pa thams cad khengs te tsha bas tshig nas brgyal ba tsam du bsams nas/ padma myur du 'khor ba la shes pa ma yangs par gtad pas lus me'i gong bur 'gyur ro// lha sku rang shar dang yul snang gtan la phebs pa dang*/ 'od gsal la sogs pa'i gsal snang dang*/

mthong snang myur du 'ong bar 'dod na/ lte ba'i a dang yi ge bzhi 'od kyi rang bzhin du bsams pas/ nyin mtshan kun tu ma yengs par bya/ khyad par du a'i 'od kyis spyir khong pa'i nang dang*/ khyad par du lte ba'i nang thams cad 'od kyis khengs shing*/ 'od kyi nang na a gsal ba de las ma yengs par bya/ de dmigs pa gtso bas gnyid dang 'gro 'chag sogs kyi dus su/ dmigs pa brtan par bya ba gal che gsung*/ bzlas pa dang dmigs pa de rnams la skyo na bde bas bsdu par bya ste/ a las 'od 'phros nam mkha' thams cad khengs/ lha'i bu mo'i gsang gnas nas byang sems dmar po'i rnam par bkug nas/ yi ge bzhi la thim pa dang bde phril phril byung bar bsam/ de bzhin du gzhan lnga la yang bya'o// gang dbang du bya ba de mang po dpag tu med par sprul nas rje btsun ma la 'bul ba de zab par 'dug pas nyams myong gis grub pa yin gsungs so/ gsang sgrub kyi zhal gdams la lhag ma gcig kyang bzhag re kan/ mchog thun mong gi dngos grub lo zla tsam gyis 'byung ba'i gnad kyi man ngag su kha siddhi nas brgyud pa'o/// /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs btud nas/ (322)lte ba sprul 'khor bri bar bya// rang skad cig gis rje btsun mar bskyed pa'i lte bar/ e las chos 'byung gru gsum phyi dkar la nang dmar ba gcig bsam/ de'i nang du padma dmar po 'dab ma bzhi pa gcig gi lte ba las/ mdun du ha/ g.yas su ri/ rgyab tu ni/ g.yon du sa swā hā/ de ltar yi ge 'bru bdun po de las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi dbang gi nus pa dang phrin las thams cad ma lus par bsdus nas yi ge /padma chos 'byung dang bcas pa la bstim mo// des yig 'bru rnams dmang zhing dbang gi nus pa phun sum tshogs par bsam/ de ltar nus pa dang phrin las thams cad kyi bkrag gzi brjid dang ldan pa'i yi ge de rnams las 'od 'phros/

srid pa gsum po thams cad 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas khengs par bsam/ de dag thams cad 'od dmar por gyur/ skye 'gro sems can du gyur pa thams cad kyi 'dod yon thams cad tshur bsdus pa dang*/ srid gsum bkrag nyams par bsam/ de ltar 'dod yon thams cad chos 'byung du bsdus pa dang*/ yi ge padma rnams bkrag gi rang bzhin du gyur/ yang yig 'bru las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu 'phros/ bsgrub bya gang yin pa de rang dbang med par byung nas padma'i steng du bstim/ de nas yi ge'i steng du bla ma sku mdog dmar po gcig bsam la/ chos 'byung kha bsdus pa dang bla ma las 'od dmar po byung nas bsgrub bya de la phog pa dang*/ lus dmar ltem ste song nas/ lus ngag yid gsum bcer bur bsams te/ de yang lus gcer bu gos med par phyag byed pa/ ngag gcer bu ngag gus pa/ yid gcer bu dad pa gus pa gdung shugs chen po dung dung 'bral (323)mi phod par bsams la/ padma myur du 'khor ba/ yi ge mi 'khor bar 'od 'phro bar bsams la/ lus mi gnas sgul bskyod/ ngag mi gnas bzlas pa/ yid mi gnas pho la byams pa/ mo la chags pa/ nor la bdun pa drag po'o// bsgrub bya yang bstim pa dang*/ bla ma la mos gus zhung zhung byed par bsam/ bla ma shangs pa'i gsang sgrub lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo la brten nas mchog thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad mi 'byung mi srid pa'i zhal gdams so/// /nyer sgrub kyi skabs su rang rje btsun mar bsgoms la/ grub na bzlas pa gzhung bzhin bya/ ma grub na rang rje btsun mar bskyed pa'i mdun du bsgrub bya yod na rab/ med na gsal bar bsam pa'am/ yang na a'i 'od kyis bkug la de'i chos 'byung nang du padma 'dab bzhi yi ge dang bcas pa/ ji ltar bsgoms pa bzhin du bsams nas/ lus mi gnas sgul bskyod/ ngag mi gnas bzlas pa/ yid mi gnas chos nyid la bzhag nas/ ngag tu ha ri ni sa dga' zhes brjod pa dang*/

chos 'byung gi padma dbang med du myur du 'khor bas/ de'i 'od kyis rtsa bo che dang rtsa phran thams cad dral te/ yul de bde bas brgyal ba dang*/ gsang gnas na mar la byang sems them bu btang ba bzhin dmar na ra ra byung ste/ rang gi mthe bong g.yas pa'i 'og tu hril hril byung ba dang*/ rang nyid dmar ldem gyis song bar bsam/ de'i mdangs kyis yul de kha dog dmar zhing yid myos pa dang*/ dad gus byed par bsgom/ oṃ ha ri ni sa lha'i bu mo'i lte ba'i 'og nas bde ba khug ces bya'o// bde ba de rang la bsdu'o// / ༈ mkha' 'gro su kha siddhis/ gnyan ston pra dzñā la gdams pa gzer (324) gsum gyi man ngag yod/ gu ru ratna/ tsakra saṃ bha ra/ shrī badzra yo gi ni/ na mo/ mkha' 'gro bde ba'i dngos grub la phyag 'tshal lo// gsang sgrub lte ba sprul 'khor gyi// khyad 'phags gzer gsum zhal gdams ni// spyi bor bla ma dam pa'i gzer// snying ga yi dam bde mchog ste// lte ba mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'o// dang po bla ma'i mos gus kyis// sa bcu lam lnga lo dang zlas bgrod 'dod na// bde ba'i stan la skyil krung bcas// sems bskyed tshad med sngon song pas// rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma// sku mdog gi gzer phyag mtshan gsal 'i gzer ba yi// spyi bor pad ma dang nyi'i steng du ni// hūm̐ yig nag po bsam par bya// de las 'od 'phros sems can smin grol sangs rgyas mchod don gnyis byas// tshur 'dus hūm̐ de gyur pa las// bir wa pa dang dgyes mdzad 'dra// tha dad med par bsam par bya// rang gi rdo rje'i bum sa ste nor bla'i nang du// chos 'byung kha dog dmar po yi// nang du yi ge a dkar las// 'od 'phros don byas tshur 'dus pas// a de bdag med ma dang ni// su kha siddhi gnyis med bsgom// de nas rlung gnyis kha sbyar te// steng 'og dmigs bir wa dang su kha siddhi gnyis

pa gsal ba dang*// rang lus g.yas su gcus pa yi// bdag med ma ni lte bar byung*// g.yon du gcus pas snying ga ste// de bzhin g.yas g.yon sbyor ba yis// mgrin pa nas ni spyi gtsug gi /tshangs bug nas ni yab kyud kyis la 'khyud// gnyis su med pa'i snyoms 'jug gis// zag med bde ba rgyas par bsam// de yi mdun du rang nyid dang po spyi bor bla ma'i gzer kyi/ rtsa ba'i bla ma bsgom par bya// dgyes mdzad yab yum bla ma dang*// bcas pa gsal bar bsgom (325)pa la// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bskor bar bsam// de la rang sems gzhan du ma yengs par rtse gcig tu gdung ba yis// hūm̐ ring bir wa pa hūm̐ su kha ma siddhi haṃ zhes gsol ba drag tu gdab// nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ rtse gcig gsol ba btab gyur na// phyi nang bar chad zhi ba dang*// 'du ba rnam mkha' 'gro zas nor gsum dngos su 'byung*// khyad mkha' 'gro par bde ba dngos grub bdag gis*/ /dngos su byin rlobs dngos grub ster// sa bcu lam lnga lo zlas bgrod// thun gzhan dang mong ma yin gsol 'debs so/ rang nyid rje btsun rnal 'byor ma'i// thugs kar yi dam bde mchog ni// gsal la rtog pa mchog thun mong gnyis kyi med pa la// ma yengs bsgoms shing sngags bzlas na// rmi lam du yang rang shar 'byung*// de ni longs sku dngos yin no// lte ba

gsum pa mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i gzer// a yi 'od kyis bsregs byas te// mi lus ngag yid gsum gnas gsum du nyams blangs na// mchog dang thun mong lo zlas 'grub// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i// gsang sgrub nye bar sgrub pa 'di// bsdu dang dgug dang bde ba bsdu// dang po skyabs 'gro bzlas pa bya// de nas bsgrub bya yul gyi gnad// chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum du// padma 'dab bzhi yig 'brur bcas// 'od kyi rang bzhin gsal bar sgrub thabs ltar bsgom// de nas a yi 'od zer gyis// yig 'bru bzhi po gnad bskul nas// ha ri ni sa dga' zhes pa// ngag tu brjod pas rkyen byas nas// yig 'bru padma'i 'od zer gyis// rtsa chen rtsa phran thams cad khengs// bsgrub bya bde ba rgyas gyur nas// bde ba'i rgyu ni rtsa thams cad nas g.yos gyur (326)te// 'byung bzhi'i dwangs ma nyi ma ni// them bu btang pa bzhin byung nas// rang nyid rje btsun mar gsal ba'i// zhabs g.yas mthe bong 'og tu ni// me tog hril hril 'dus par bsam// rang dang bsgrub bya gang yin pa// rgya skag mdog ltar gyur nas kyang*// gus sgrub byed bdag la ldan pa dang zhing bde ba rgyas par bsam// mi gnas lus lha ngag sngags sems chos nyid gsum po gsal ba gces// de nas dgug pa'i sbyor ba ni// chos rab chos 'byung gzhal yas su// padma yig 'bru gong bzhin bsam// khyad par a ni dmar po las// 'od zer dmar po 'phros pa yis// yi ge bzhi yi gsang gnas song*// drod kyis yi ge'i bde ba'i gnas bskul nas// padma g.yas bskor dbang med drag 'khor te// padmas padma bcad pa dang*// rang byung me tog bcas nas su// byung ste mthe bong g.yas ba'i 'og /hril hril dbang med 'dus bsam mnan// padma bcad cing mnan pa dang*// 'od zer dmar po 'phros pa yis// rtsa khengs bde ba rgyas gyur pas// lus dmar gus ldan nyams shed chung*// blta mi phod cing nyi ma'i rgyun/

rkang 'og dbang med 'dus par bsam// bcad dang rang byung res mos bsgom// sngags ni gong bzhin bzlas par bya// rjes la gsang ba'i gnas su bstim// sngon du bsnyen pa thems pa dang*// rang dang mdun bskyed gsal ba gsum// 'dzom par gyur na skad cig gcig gis ni// mi gnas ma yengs bsgoms gyur na// 'du ba gsum dang 'char ba lus bde ngag nus sems rtogs pa gsum// lo zla tsam gyis 'grub par 'gyur// dbang bzhi khyad 'phags chu rgyun gyis// bde ba bsdu ba'i rim pa ni// snod ldan gzhan la bskur maṇḍal sogs byas nas ba'o/ rang (327)nyid nyams su len pa'i tshe// skyabs 'gro bzlas pa nas tsam ste grub tshad bya// de nas rang nyid bde mchog gi /lte ba'i a las 'od 'phros pas// lha mo mdog dkar bal ser ba'i gzi mdangs can// bde ba'i mdangs ldan gzhon sha sgeg /pañtsa li lha'i gos dang rin po che// sna tshogs brgyan pa'i gsang gnas su// 'od de phog pas mdun du byon// de yi gsang gnas gsal bar bsgom// de nas rang gi dbang po'i rtser// mthing nag hūm̐ las 'od zer lnga// 'phros pas chos 'byung gnas su song*// rtsa 'dab khengs pas bde ba rgyas// de yi bde ba'i 'od zer gyis// tshur la drag tu bsdus nas ni// rang gi dbang po'i gnas na yar// song nas rtsa 'dab thams cad rje btsun mas khengs// de yis bde ba skyes pa dang*// 'og rlung drag bskum lha mo'i/ bsus pa sbyar// bde stong gnyis su med par bsgom// yang gcig hūm̐ las 'od 'phros nas// bde ba gong bzhin bkug pa yis// rang lus zag med bde bas rgyas// gsal stong gnyis su med par bsgom// de nas lha mo rje btsun ma// rang la gnyis med 'khyud nas ni// thabs dang shes rab bsrubs pa yis// drod kyis bde ba'i gnad bskul nas// yum gyi rang byung nyi ma'i rgyun// bde ba phun sum tshogs pa de// rdo rje nas ni khong pa yi// nang na yar la song ba yis// rtsa chen rtsa phran thams cad khengs// bde bas rgyud ni gang zhing rgyas// rang lus zag med bde ba rgyas// rang lus rakta'i mdog ltar gyur// de yis yum ni dbang du 'du// rang gi de kun phar 'phros pas// yum de bde ba rgyas gyur nas// dkar

yum gyi mdog la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pas// yum ni yab kyi dbang du 'gyur// de ltar yab yum 'od 'khrug cing*/ (328)bde bas rgyud ni gang ba'i tshe// 'og rlung drag tu bskum pa dang*// bde bas stong pa'i don bstan cing*// stong pas bde la chags mi bya// bde stong gnyis med ye shes mchog /dmar ba yun ring dkar ba thung*// gnad kyi mchog tu shes par bya// snang stong lha sku bde chen la// gsal la rtog pa med par bzhag /de ltar yab yum gnyis med kyi// ngang nas bzlas pa bya ba ni// oṃ ha ri ni sa la sogs bzlas// de yis lha sku phyag rgya che// zhen pa'i dri ma thams cad dang*// bral bas rang shar dag tu 'gyur// de yis gang 'dul lhun gyis grub// de ni mthar thug 'bras bu'o// dri za bram ze gdol pa dang*// mi dang klu la de bzhin no// thun mong ma yin dbang bzhi 'di// snod dang ldan pas nyams blangs na// 'du ba gsum dang 'tshar gsum 'byung*// khyad par su kha siddhi bdag gis dngos grub ster// rje btsun ma ni drug po yang*// lo zlas zhal mthong yum gyur nas// bcu gsum sa la 'gro bar 'gyur// de skad su kha siddhis gsungs// ston ka rin chen 'byung ldan dus// ḍā ki 'du ba'i ri gong du// zhag bdun bar du bzhugs nas kyang*// su kha siddhis sangs rgyas dbang bzhi bskur zhing gsang sngags kyi gnad rnams gsungs// rnam dag bde chen lung bstan mdzad// 'gro 'dul su kha siddhi yis/ gnyan ston dharma pra dzña chos kyi shes rab la// ḍā kis ji skad gsung bzhin gnyan ston gyis su kha siddhis yi ger bkod// slob ma gcig las mang su kha siddhis na bka' rgya yod// / maṅga laṃ/
